spec.query:
SELECT SUM("delta_value") AS "total_bành_mủ"
FROM (
    SELECT NON_NEGATIVE_DERIVATIVE(LAST("value"), 1m) AS "delta_value"
    FROM "caosu_measurement"
    WHERE (
        "system"::tag = 'Hệ Mủ Tạp' 
        AND "machine_name"::tag = 'Số bành mủ'
    )
    AND $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(1m)
)

spec.query:
SELECT 
    SUM("energy") AS "energy",
    LAST("energy_lat") AS "energy_lat",
    LAST("energy_lon") AS "energy_lon"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM("delta_value") / 1000 AS "energy",
        LAST("latitude") AS "energy_lat",
        LAST("longitude") AS "energy_lon"
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            NON_NEGATIVE_DERIVATIVE(LAST("value"), 1h) AS "delta_value",
            LAST("latitude") AS "latitude",
            LAST("longitude") + 0.002 AS "longitude"
        FROM "caosu_measurement"
        WHERE (
            "system"::tag = 'Hệ Mủ Tạp' 
            AND "machine_name"::tag = 'Điện Năng Tiêu Thụ'
        )
        AND $timeFilter
        GROUP BY time(1h), "machine_name"::tag
    )
    WHERE $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(7d, -7h), "machine_name"::tag fill(none)
)

SELECT 
    SUM("water") AS "water",
    LAST("water_latitude") AS "water_latitude",
    LAST("water_longitude") AS "water_longitude"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM("delta_value") AS "water",
        LAST("latitude") AS "water_latitude",
        LAST("longitude") AS "water_longitude"
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            NON_NEGATIVE_DERIVATIVE(LAST("value"), 1h) AS "delta_value",
            LAST("latitude") AS "latitude",
            LAST("longitude") + 0.004 AS "longitude"
        FROM "caosu_measurement"
        WHERE (
            "system"::tag = 'Hệ Mủ Tạp' 
            AND "machine_name"::tag = 'Lượng Nước Tiêu Thụ'
        )
        AND $timeFilter
        GROUP BY time(1h), "machine_name"::tag
    )
    WHERE $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(7d, -7h), "machine_name"::tag fill(none)
)

SELECT 
    SUM("delta_value") AS "counter",
    LAST("latitude") AS "latitude",
    LAST("longitude") AS "longitude"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        NON_NEGATIVE_DERIVATIVE(LAST("value"), 1m) AS "delta_value",
        LAST("latitude") - 0.0016 AS "latitude",
        LAST("longitude") + 0.0015 AS "longitude"
    FROM "caosu_measurement"
    WHERE 
        "system"::tag = 'Hệ Mủ Tạp' 
        AND "machine_name"::tag = 'Số bành mủ'
        AND $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(1m)
)

SELECT "value" AS "energy", "latitude" -0.0005 AS "energy_lat1", "longitude" +0.0015 AS "energy_lon1" FROM "caosu_measurement" WHERE ("machine_name"::tag = 'Điện Năng Tiêu Thụ') AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "value" AS "counter", "latitude" - 0.0016, "longitude" + 0.0015 FROM "caosu_measurement" WHERE ("machine_name"::tag = 'Số bành mủ') AND $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
